configuration.information_convention: SNR_squared=4I for coherent white Gaussian output; not fidelity

definitions.information: I = kappa_b integral [Re(beta_minus-beta_plus)]^2 dt; counted only through read-drive end; later emitted signal excluded. For unit-Wiener homodyne current, squared mean separation/noise = 4 eta I; coherent Gaussian equal-prior error = Phi(-sqrt(eta I)).
definitions.array_axes: expects[initial_branch, observable, saved_time]; time in microseconds; raw complex expectations retained
definitions.logical_basis: C_even/odd are normalized even/odd cats at alpha_storage. Logical plus/minus=(C_even +/- C_odd)/sqrt(2). Wrong population is expects[0,6,-1] or expects[1,7,-1]. No postselection.
definitions.control: alpha(t)=alpha_storage+(alpha_readout-alpha_storage)[s(t/ramp)-s((t-ramp-read_time)/ramp)], s(u)=10u^3-15u^4+6u^5 on clipped u in [0,1]. epsilon_d=g2*alpha(t)^2. epsilon_Z=ratio*g2 on [ramp,ramp+read_time), zero otherwise. ramp=0 keeps alpha=alpha_storage.
definitions.rate: Gamma_X is an observable population-imbalance relaxation exponent; one-way rate Gamma_X/2 only for symmetric switching.

result.interpretation: Only the positive initial codeword is integrated. Zero memory drive gives exact unitary memory-parity symmetry, so negative-codeword wrong probability is identical.

comparison.scope: Direct integrated idle at28x10; conservative at38x16. Idle static rate cutoff28x10 versus32x12 differs0.18%; finite-pulse cutoff differences are separately reported.
